description: Real washing machine runs, reported 2026-11: three Super Speed 30 and three Super Speed 40, labelled by hand. Time anonymised (runs one day apart from 0, in their original order), trace rounded to 0.1 s / 0.1 W. The two programs differ mainly in heating time: 0.39-0.46 against 0.60-0.76 kWh.
